0.0: Hello #b#h0##k, what's up?\r\n#L0##bI am going to visit a friend and I've been told I should bring a souvenir.#l\n#k
0.1: Ah, yes, I am very experienced in receiving gifts. Tell me about your friend.\r\n#L0##bYou are statistically very close to them. What would you like?#l\n#k
0.2: Most people tend to buy me beard softeners, expensive hair products, or... I guess #bbooks#k. In fact, I've got a whole pile of those things, if you want one.

yes.0: Feel free to grab one off of one of the #bbook piles#k around here. I couldn't care less.

no.0: Not a fan of the book idea? I'm always disappointed too. There are so many words...

1.0: Ah, is that #t4033644#.\r\n#L0##bIt was on top of the pile... Is it good?#l\n#k
1.1: I have no idea. Reading gives me hives.\r\n#L0##bOh, then how did you get to be a professor?#l\n#k
1.2: People just naturally do whatever I say. I'm very smart.

yes.0: This book has a nice cover and soft edges, I'm sure your friend will enjoy it.
